comments: The server performs file validation after saving the upload to disk. By sending concurrent GET requests to the expected file path (/files/avatars/exploit.php) while the upload is in flight, we can execute the PHP shell in the brief window before the server validates and removes it. The 403 on upload confirms the file was rejected by validation, but the race condition allowed execution before deletion.
